scope: Methodological companion to PRC extraction and independent review. Literature methods are supporting evidence, not scientific project rules.
purpose: Help a fresh model identify consequential source-stated requirements, preserve their normative force and fill source-supported fields without inventing obligations.
attribution: The category labels, PK examples, source-adoption decisions and integrated workflow below are project-specific design. The cited studies support individual techniques; none validates this PK proposal-to-rules pipeline.

references.title: GoLLIE: Annotation Guidelines Improve Zero-Shot Information-Extraction
references.method: Guideline-conditioned structured extraction with label definitions, examples and argument descriptions. The model was fine-tuned to use these guidelines.
references.use_here: Provide precise extraction categories, slot definitions and illustrative boundary cases.
references.limit: This is not evidence that prompting any off-the-shelf API with the same material reproduces GoLLIE's accuracy.

references.title: Extraction of Information Provision Activity Requirements from EU Acquis
references.method: Separates requirement detection from structured slot extraction; compares lexical patterns, classifiers and LLM prompts with examples and JSON outputs.
references.use_here: Separate candidate identification from field filling and assess their errors separately.
references.limit: The task concerns information-provision duties; it excludes nondisclosure requirements and does not validate our broader PK requirement taxonomy. Its modality expansion is future work.

references.title: LLM-assisted Extraction of Regulatory Requirements: A Case Study on the GDPR
references.inspected: Institutional metadata/abstract and indexed primary-PDF methods excerpts. Full-PDF download was not completed.
references.method: XTRAREG uses predefined legal sources, LLM prompting and retrieval augmentation; its study created 108 expert requirements.
references.use_here: Fix the admitted source set, supply relevant source context and inspect completeness separately from whether extracted items look correct.
references.limit: Legal-to-software requirement derivation is broader than faithful extraction here. Do not derive new PK obligations, rely on model memory, or treat retrieval results as proof of complete coverage.

references.title: Easy Approach to Requirements Syntax (EARS)
references.authors: Alistair Mavin, Philip Wilkinson, Adrian Harwood and Mark Novak
references.method: Lightweight requirement patterns separate triggering events, relevant states, conditions and required behavior.
references.use_here: Use optional semantic slots when representing conditional project requirements.
references.limit: This is a foundational representation method, not a modern LLM extractor. Do not force every clause into a template, promote suggestions to SHALL, infer unstated requirements, or claim templates prove completeness.

references.title: Approaching the AI Act... with AI: LLMs and knowledge graphs to extract and analyse obligations
references.year_note: Journal issue: Volume 60, April 2026; DOI and copyright contain 2025.
references.inspected: Publisher abstract and data-availability statement via indexed publisher page; full text and repository contents not inspected.
references.method: A modular pipeline identifies obligations, filters deontic statements, analyzes them and builds knowledge graphs. It uses Llama 3.3 70B with NLP tools.
references.use_here: Distinguish normative statements from surrounding descriptive text before assembling rule records.
references.limit: The abstract reports selected-stage expert evaluation. It does not establish end-to-end completeness, PK validity or that a knowledge graph is necessary here.

references.title: Trustworthy Regulatory Requirements Extraction using Local LLM: A Multi-Agent vs. Single-Prompt Benchmark on the EU AI Act and GDPR
references.authors: Mishaal Ahmed and Muhammad Ajmal Naz
references.venue: IEEE 2nd International Conference on AI and Emerging Technology for Sustainable Future; institutional record
references.inspected: Institutional repository abstract only; full manuscript not inspected.
references.method: Compares matched-content structured prompting with a sequential Analyst-Engineer-QA workflow using one local Llama 3 8B.
references.use_here: Treat additional calls as a cost/quality hypothesis rather than an automatic improvement.
references.limit: The abstract reports better F1 for its single-call baseline than the multi-agent variant. One model and two legal corpora do not establish a universal rule or justify removing our existing independent audit.

method_steps.name: Define the annotation task
method_steps.procedure: Supply category meanings, inclusion/exclusion boundaries and a few relevant contrast examples before extraction. Use the project's input schema rather than relying on label names or model-specific keyword conventions.

method_steps.name: Find candidate obligations
method_steps.procedure: Inspect each admitted source unit with its parent context. Identify directive intent, scope and adoption separately; retain non-rule and ambiguous dispositions. Cue terms aid attention but must not be the only inclusion filter.

method_steps.name: Fill requirement slots
method_steps.procedure: Extract the action and its source-stated actor/target, force, conditions, exceptions and use timing. Keep related alternatives and qualifiers connected. An unspecified field stays unspecified.

method_steps.name: Bind context and evidence
method_steps.procedure: Link original clauses and any needed definitions, tables or cross-references from admitted sources. Distinguish evidence for meaning from evidence for project adoption. Inaccessible material becomes a targeted finding, not an inferred rule.

method_steps.name: Organize and review the final collection
method_steps.procedure: Use shared deduplication rules, retain source/candidate/final mappings and check missed requirements separately from unsupported additions, wrong slots and altered conditions. Use the existing final independent review.

annotation_guide.status: PROJECT_DESIGN_FOR_REVIEW; illustrative labels require schema mapping before runtime use

classification.label: REQUIRED_ACTION
classification.definition: The effective project specification commits the analysis or workflow to an action, deliverable or choice.
classification.include: Explicit directives or unambiguous adopted project commitments, even without must/shall.
classification.exclude: Predicted future events, descriptive study methods and optional suggestions.

classification.label: PROHIBITION
classification.definition: The project forbids a stated action or use within a stated scope.
classification.include: Explicit exclusions, access/use restrictions and negative obligations.
classification.exclude: Statements that a result was not observed or a method was not used in a cited study.

classification.label: PERMITTED_USE_BOUNDARY
classification.definition: The project explicitly defines what use is allowed and under which limits.
classification.include: Restrictions such as use only for initialization or use only after approval.
classification.exclude: Do not turn permission to do something into a duty to do it.

classification.label: RECOMMENDATION_OR_OPTION
classification.definition: A suggested or optional action that has not been adopted as a binding constraint.
classification.include: Consider, could and preference language when context is genuinely optional.
classification.exclude: Do not discard a conditional mandatory instruction merely because it contains if or may.

classification.label: NON_RULE
classification.definition: A pure objective, descriptive fact, result, assumption or explanatory statement.
classification.include: Refer to the compression-owned context and record the non-rule disposition.
classification.exclude: An explicit instruction to use an assumption is a rule even though the assumption itself is not a verified fact.

classification.label: UNRESOLVED_REQUIREMENT
classification.definition: A potentially consequential obligation whose meaning, force, adoption or scope cannot be settled from the admitted evidence.
classification.exclude: A later-stage data gap with clear rule meaning is not automatically an extraction failure.

cue_terms.purpose: Non-exhaustive reading aids; no regex-only filter or keyword-based proof of obligation.
cue_terms.interpretation: Use sentence and document context. Preserve SHOULD/MAY strength, distinguish possibility from permission, and do not normalize ambiguous may not to a prohibition without evidence.

slot_guide.action: What must be done, avoided or limited.
slot_guide.actor_or_target: Who acts or what analysis, dataset, parameter or output is constrained.
slot_guide.normative_force: Source-stated obligation, prohibition, conditional permission or recommendation; never upgraded for formatting.
slot_guide.exceptions_and_alternatives: Retain exclusions, AND/OR structure and linked options.
slot_guide.scientific_scope: Use the canonical scientific preservation profile for relevant PK details.
slot_guide.usage_timing: Separate consuming stage and required phase from the scientific observation window.
slot_guide.evidence_and_adoption: Original source spans and project adoption references; they may be the same source.
slot_guide.missing_slots: Record the existing contract's explicit missingness state and raise a question only if the missing item changes interpretation or publication.

synthetic_examples.status: ILLUSTRATIVE_AUTHOR_WRITTEN_CASES; not study data, project instructions or a validated benchmark

cases.source: Use free-drug exposure for all PK/PD index comparisons.
cases.avoid: Do not apply the requirement to unrelated total-concentration PK fitting.

cases.source: The cited study used a two-compartment model.
cases.avoid: A reported model choice is not a project mandate.

cases.source: For this project, use the cited two-compartment structure, but do not import its parameter values.
cases.avoid: Do not infer permission to reuse parameters from adoption of a structure.
Do not require a third compartment or turn the suggestion into a release gate.

cases.source: If verified individual-animal data are available, estimate animal random effects.
cases.avoid: Do not invent individual IDs from group means or make the instruction unconditional.

cases.source: Literature parameters may be used only as starting values.
cases.avoid: Do not mandate literature initialization or permit fixed final parameter adoption.

cases.source: Use either candidate A or candidate B.
cases.avoid: Splitting must not create two simultaneous mandatory actions.

cases.source: Human binding data are reserved for final validation and must not be used during initial extrapolation.
cases.source_context: Synthetic adopted protocol; existence of such data is not assumed
cases.avoid: Do not require those data now or claim they have been supplied.

cases.source_context: Adopted project protocol without a definition of acceptable
cases.avoid: Do not invent an RSE, AIC, sample-size or convergence threshold.

quality_assessment.proposed_metrics: With sufficient labelled material, evaluate precision/recall of requirements, slot correctness, grounding and critical semantic failures separately. Text similarity, valid JSON or a plausible explanation alone is insufficient.
quality_assessment.current_limit: These references and synthetic examples do not establish performance on real project documents. The full labelled blind benchmark remains deferred under the existing qualification decision.

execution_design.model_independence: Definitions, evidence references and JSON fields are portable across models/APIs; per-model accuracy is not assumed.
execution_design.calls: Detection and slot filling are logical phases inside the existing extractor. Retain the existing independent reviewer; no extra mandatory agent or model call per method step.
execution_design.retrieval: Use source-aware retrieval only where the assigned materials require it; maintain source coverage. Top-k retrieval is not a completeness certificate.
execution_design.host_checks: Validate schema, IDs, source-span locations, allowed references and mapping integrity deterministically. These checks do not replace semantic review.
not_added: Training an SVM or lexical classifier without a suitable dataset
